resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a standard biometric update because the number of unique de-duplication candidates exceeded the permitted limit even though the applicant was whitelisted.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update and the capture matched more records than policy allows an operator to adjudicate for one packet. The whitelist already in place raises the review threshold but not the candidate-count ceiling, so no automated route remains open. The oversized candidate set needs human adjudication before the update can proceed.
